annotations.title: Check ERC-8004 AgentId Trust & Sybil Score

description: Retrieve an ERC-8004 registered agent's composite trust score (0-100), letter grade (A-F), historical clearing count, and Sybil wash-trading penalty flags by numeric agentId. Returns arbiter-signed reputation metrics and sybilFlags. Use this ONLY for registered ERC-8004 agent IDs (e.g. '124595'); for raw 0x wallet address OFAC/balance profiling use nullclear_score_wallet, and for legal corporate liability limits use nullclear_verify_mandate.

agentId.description: Registered numeric ERC-8004 agent token ID (e.g. '124595')

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID (8453 for Base Mainnet, 84532 for Base Sepolia)

name: nullclear_check_reputation
